import sys, json, subprocess, os, tempfile
import importlib.util
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, "/app")

def load_mod(path, name):
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(name, path)
    m = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    spec.loader.exec_module(m)
    return m

# ---- load_payload edge cases ----
from importlib import util
fstab_model = load_mod("/app/domains/fstab/model.py", "fstab_model")
load_payload = fstab_model.load_payload
p = Path("/tmp/opencode/t/bad.json")
for content, name in [("{'x':", "invalid json"), ("NaN", "top NaN"), ("[1, NaN]", "nested NaN"),
                      ("Infinity", "inf"), ('"str"', "top string"), ("true", "top bool"), ("42", "top int")]:
    p.write_text(content)
    try:
        load_payload(p); print("FAIL no raise:", name); sys.exit(1)
    except ValueError:
        pass
p.write_text('{"a": [1.5, {"b": null}]}')
assert load_payload(p) == {"a": [1.5, {"b": None}]}

ft = load_mod("/app/domains/fstab/transform.py", "ft")
at = load_mod("/app/domains/aix/transform.py", "at")
mt = load_mod("/app/domains/mount/transform.py", "mt")
mg = load_mod("/app/views/merged/transform.py", "mg")

C = lambda name, inputs: {"name": name, "inputs": inputs}

# ---- common contract/payload validation ----
samples = {"fstab": "d m t rw", "aix": "/m:\n  dev = d", "mount": "d on /m type t (rw)"}
expected = {"fstab": {"device": "d", "mount": "m", "fstype": "t", "options": "rw"},
            "aix": {"device": "d", "mount": "/m", "fstype": "jfs2", "options": "rw"},
            "mount": {"device": "d", "mount": "/m", "fstype": "t", "options": "rw"}}
for t, key in ((ft, "fstab"), (at, "aix"), (mt, "mount")):
    for bad_contract in ({}, {"name": "n"}, {"inputs": ["a"]}):
        try: t.transform([{key: samples[key]}], bad_contract); print("FAIL contract", key); sys.exit(1)
        except ValueError: pass
    try: t.transform([{key: samples[key]}], C("n", ["a", "b"])); print("FAIL count", key); sys.exit(1)
    except ValueError: pass
    try: t.transform([{key: 5}], C("n", ["a"])); print("FAIL type", key); sys.exit(1)
    except ValueError: pass
    try: t.transform([{"other": "x"}], C("n", ["a"])); print("FAIL missing", key); sys.exit(1)
    except ValueError: pass
    r = t.transform([{"name": "whatever", "result": {key: samples[key]}}], C("n", ["a"]))
    assert r == {"name": "n", "result": {"records": [expected[key]]}}, r

# ---- fstab specifics ----
for bad in ["a b c", "a b c d e f g"]:
    try: ft.transform([{"fstab": bad}], C("n", ["a"])); print("FAIL fstab cols"); sys.exit(1)
    except ValueError: pass
r = ft.transform([{"fstab": "\\134040 /m t rw"}], C("n", ["a"]))
assert r["result"]["records"][0]["device"] == "\\040", r
r = ft.transform([{"fstab": "/dev\\040x /m\\011y t rw,ro,rw"}], C("n", ["a"]))
assert r["result"]["records"][0] == {"device": "/dev x", "mount": "/m\ty", "fstype": "t", "options": "ro,rw"}, r
assert ft.transform([{"fstab": "# c\n\n  \n"}], C("n", ["a"]))["result"]["records"] == []
r = ft.transform([{"fstab": "/d /m t rw 0 2\n/d2 /m2 t ro"}], C("n", ["a"]))
assert len(r["result"]["records"]) == 2

# ---- aix specifics ----
for bad, name in [
    ({"aix": "dev = x"}, "attr before header"),
    ({"aix": "/m:\n  dev = /d\n  bad = 1"}, "unknown key"),
    ({"aix": "/m:\n  dev = /d\n  dev = /e"}, "dup key"),
    ({"aix": "/m:\n  options = rw"}, "missing dev"),
    ({"aix": "/m no colon"}, "bad header"),
    ({"aix": "  dev = /d"}, "indented no header"),
    ({"aix": ":x"}, "empty mount"),
]:
    try: at.transform([bad], C("n", ["a"])); print("FAIL aix:", name); sys.exit(1)
    except ValueError: pass
r = at.transform([{"aix": "/m:\n  dev = /d\n  vfs = jfs\n  options = rw, sync\n# c\n"}], C("n", ["a"]))
assert r["result"]["records"] == [{"device": "/d", "mount": "/m", "fstype": "jfs", "options": "rw,sync"}], r
r = at.transform([{"aix": "/m:\n\toptions=b, a\n\tdev=/x\n"}], C("n", ["a"]))
assert r["result"]["records"] == [{"device": "/x", "mount": "/m", "fstype": "jfs2", "options": "a,b"}], r
r = at.transform([{"aix": "/a:\n dev = /d1\n/b:\n dev = /d2\n vfs = jfs\n"}], C("n", ["a"]))
assert [x["mount"] for x in r["result"]["records"]] == ["/a", "/b"]

# ---- mount specifics ----
for bad in ["dev /m type t (rw)", "dev on m type t ()", "dev on /m typ t (rw)",
            "dev on /m type t (rw) extra", "free text"]:
    try: mt.transform([{"mount": bad}], C("n", ["a"])); print("FAIL mount:", bad); sys.exit(1)
    except ValueError: pass
r = mt.transform([{"mount": "/dev/s\\040d on /m\\040p type ext4 (rw,relatime,rw)\n\n"}], C("n", ["a"]))
assert r["result"]["records"] == [{"device": "/dev/s d", "mount": "/m p", "fstype": "ext4", "options": "relatime,rw"}], r
assert mt.transform([{"mount": "\n  \n"}], C("n", ["a"]))["result"]["records"] == []

# ---- merge specifics ----
mk = lambda src, recs: {"name": src, "result": {"records": recs}}
R = lambda d, f, o, m="/m": {"device": d, "mount": m, "fstype": f, "options": o}
p1 = mk("fstab", [R("/d1", "ext4", "rw")])
p2 = mk("aix", [R("/d1", "ext4", "rw")])
p3 = mk("mount", [R("/d2", "ext4", "rw", "/other")])
r = mg.transform([p1, p2, p3], C("m", ["outputs/fstab.json", "outputs/aix.json", "outputs/mount.json"]))
assert r == {"name": "m", "result": {"records": [
    {"device": "/d1", "mount": "/m", "fstype": "ext4", "options": "rw", "source": "fstab"},
    {"device": "/d2", "mount": "/other", "fstype": "ext4", "options": "rw", "source": "mount"}],
    "conflicts": []}}, r
p2 = mk("aix", [R("/d1", "ext4", "ro")])
r = mg.transform([p1, p2, p3], C("m", ["a", "b", "c"]))
assert len(r["result"]["conflicts"]) == 1 and len(r["result"]["conflicts"][0]["evidence"]) == 2
pd = mk("fstab", [R("/d", "ext4", "rw"), R("/d", "ext4", "rw")])
r = mg.transform([pd, mk("aix", []), mk("mount", [])], C("m", ["a", "b", "c"]))
assert r["result"]["conflicts"] == []
r = mg.transform([{"records": [R("/d", "ext4", "rw")]}, {"records": []}, {"records": []}],
                 C("m", ["outputs/fstab.json", "outputs/aix.json", "outputs/mount.json"]))
assert r["result"]["records"][0]["source"] == "fstab", r
for badrec in [{"device": 1, "mount": "/m", "fstype": "t", "options": "rw"},
               {"mount": "/m", "fstype": "t", "options": "rw"}, "notdict"]:
    try: mg.transform([mk("s", [badrec]), mk("s2", []), mk("s3", [])], C("m", ["a", "b", "c"]))
        print("FAIL merge bad rec", badrec); sys.exit(1)
    except ValueError: pass

# ---- final_report attention rules ----
fr = load_mod("/app/final_report.py", "fr")
core = {"components": {
    "a": {"blocked": True}, "b": {"ok": False}, "c": {"ok": 0}, "d": {"conflicts": []},
    "e": {"missing": ["x"]}, "f": {"blocked": 1}, "g": {"records": []},
}}
rep = fr.build_report(core)
assert rep["attention"] == ["a", "b", "e"], rep
assert rep["component_count"] == 7
import hashlib
h = hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(core, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"), allow_nan=False).encode()).hexdigest()
assert rep["sha256"] == h
assert rep["title"] == "三种挂载格式的离线事实归并"

# ---- parser delegation (isolated subprocess per component) ----
COMPDIR = {"fstab": "/app/domains/fstab", "aix": "/app/domains/aix",
           "mount": "/app/domains/mount", "merged": "/app/views/merged"}
PAYLOADS = {
    "fstab": json.dumps([{"fstab": "d m t rw"}]),
    "aix": json.dumps([{"aix": "/m:\n  dev = d"}]),
    "mount": json.dumps([{"mount": "d on /m type t (rw)"}]),
    "merged": json.dumps([mk("fstab", []), mk("aix", []), mk("mount", [])]),
}

                   "assert r['name']=='n' and 'records' in r['result'], r; print('OK')" % (comp, ninputs),

    for style, code in codes.items():
        r = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-c", code], capture_output=True, text=True, env=env)
